\textbf{Justify your answers and show your work.}\emph{ }

\emph{Evaluate each algebraic expression for the given value of the
variable.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $4-5(5+x)^{2},\mbox{ for \ensuremath{x=-7}}$.\vspace{1.5in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Simplify the algebraic expression. Write all exponents as positive. }
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $7-\frac{1}{2}[3-(4-5)]$\vspace{1.5in}
\item $-(2x^{5})^{2}$\vspace{1.0in}
\item $\frac{24x^{2}y{}^{5}}{32x^{3}y^{-9}}$\vspace{2.0in}
\item $\sqrt{8}+3\sqrt{2}$
\end{enumerate}
\newpage

\emph{Perform the indicated operation and simplify.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $(4z^{5}+9z^{4}+17)-(-6z^{4}+z^{5}+13)$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $(8x-1)(x^{3}+x^{2}+x)$\vspace{2.25in}
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Factor Completely.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $x^{2}-x-6$\vspace{1.0in}
\item $4x^{3}-4x^{2}+24x$\vspace{1.75in}
\item $x^{2}-64$
\end{enumerate}
